artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 5.75-hour plan reconciling four records and six task descriptions with the PR #7-#11 review round, with three merge-gated items explicitly deferred.

memory_candidates.content: When a records-reconciliation plan must act on facts that live only on an unmerged branch, the durable structure is a per-item deferral table whose rows each name their own precondition (which PR must merge, which file must exist on main), re-resolved in a cheap read-only Phase 1 immediately before any edit. This turns a later re-run into a lookup rather than fresh research, and it keeps the plan from asserting as current design something that exists only on a contributor's branch -- the specific hazard a 'record edits already landed by the PR' artifact is written to prevent.
